caption: The drawing depicts a single stoneware jar with a lid, positioned upright against a plain, light beige background. The jar is cylindrical with a slightly bulbous body that tapers inward toward the top, forming a narrow neck and a rounded lip. The color of the jar is an earthy light brown or tan, with subtle shading indicating light and shadow on its surface. In the center of the jar's body, there is a simple blue decorative motif that resembles a stylized feather, leaf, or abstract flourish. The lid is similarly colored to the jar, with a small knob at the top center, and it sits neatly within the rim of the jar. The signature of the artist appears in small letters near the bottom right of the drawing. There are no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
